description: Cabildo Insular de La Palma: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Cabildo Insular de La Palma. Coverage: Cabildo Insular de La Palma. The listing groups 15 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: planta hidroelectrica los mulatos; central electrica; ambito potencial solar; ambito potencial solar eolico. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.opendatalapalma.es/pages/avisolegal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
